title: Wire lichend slot-claim broadcast to next_claim_seq() sender path
description: Follow-up from l1qw.20 (closed, commit dcb6bc7b70). The sender-side claim_seq machinery is now wired and fail-closed in lichend (CLAIM_SEQ_STORE + next_claim_seq(), rust/lichen-gateway/src/bin/lichend.rs:99-121), but nothing in production calls it: the slot-claim broadcast/consumer path (GatewayCoordinator re-claim after 4.09 Conflict, periodic schedule broadcast) still doesn't emit signed claims. Wire the claim-broadcast consumer to obtain its sequence from next_claim_seq() (via tokio::task::spawn_blocking per the documented blocking contract), then call coordinator.record_own_claim_envelope() so the 4.09 Conflict path echoes a real envelope instead of the empty-payload fallback (resources.rs:2152-2154). Labels: gcp, lci, spec-gap.
